setup.price_basis: bid quotes; buys pay the spread
setup.stop_out: equity <= 0 at a close -> flat at the next open, no further trades

selection.rule: highest validation-period Sharpe (P&L-based, zero risk-free rate) at baseline costs

luck_yardstick.note: E[max of n standard normals] / sqrt(years): the Sharpe a best-of-n pick reaches by luck alone; correlated variants lower it.

D_runtime.config: MA(20,50), 100,000 units, bid quotes + 1 pip, $3.50/side commission, stop-out off, 1-minute EURUSD
